 Order
This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail.

The applicant who is a builder and colonizer apprehends his arrest in connection with Crime No.449/2022 registered at Police Station Arera Hills, District-Bhopal for the offence punishable under Sections 420,467,468,471 and 120-B of IPC.
The allegation against the present applicant is that he used forged seal and signatures of the complainant to get plot no.30 released from the Municipal Corporation.
A tripartite agreement is also filed by the applicant as Annexure A/1.

sentences.text: The contention of learned senior counsel is that the lodging of FIR is a pressurizing tactics by the complainant as a civil suit has already been filed for removal of encroachment against him.
It is stated that the complainant's wife purchased plot no.29 from the society of which the applicant is builder and colonizer.
However, she also encroached on plot no. 30 for which a civil suit has been filed on 15.09.2020.

It is stated that to pressurize the applicant earlier a complaint was filed by the complainant before the Police Station-Awadhpuri where the property is situated, which after the enquiry was found false and no action was taken by the police authorities.
Aggrieved thereby, the complainant thereafter filed an application under Section 156(3) of Cr.P.C.on 18.12.2020 before JMFC, Bhopal which was rejected on 05.02.2021.

Since the complaint of the complainant by the police authorities at Awadhpuri and by Court itself got rejected, he lodged another complaint,
making the same allegations, before the PS-Arera Hills, Bhopal on which the present offence has been registered.

It is further pointed out from the documents annexed to this application that the Municipal Corporation, after a detailed enquiry, has released the said plot no.30 by order dated 12.06.2020 and no allegation has been made by the Municipal Corporation against the present applicant.
It is submitted that the entire exercise done by the complainant is nothing, but to pressurize the applicant to reach to a compromise in the civil suit filed by the applicant.
It is submitted that the applicant will abide by all the terms and conditions imposed by this Court, in case the anticipatory bail is granted to him.
Learned Panel Lawyer appearing for the State has opposed the bail application.

However, he does not dispute the documents filed on record by the present applicant and also the fact that the property is situated at Awadhpuri whereas the complaint was lodged at PS-Arera Hilla, Bhopal.

Considering the documents on record, prima facie, it seems to be a civil dispute and there is substance in the argument of learned senior counsel that the entire action has been taken by the complainant only to pressurize the present applicant
,therefore, without adverting to the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

It is directed that in the event of arrest, the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rs. Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting officer.

It is further directed that the applicant shall also comply with the provisions of Section 438(2) of Cr.P.C.,and cooperate in the investigation as well as in the trial Court and will remain present before the concerned authority as and when he is called.
Certified copy as per rules.

(NANDITA DUBEY) JUDGE jk Narendra Bhakt vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/115187315/
